name: Chuquimamani-Condori
description:
'''Elly Crampton Chuquimia Quiñones-Tancara''', [[Aymara language|Aymara]] name '''Chuquimamani-Condori''', is an American [[electronic music]] artist, poet and composer. Their music has been described in music criticism as being based around [[Andean music]] and [[cumbia]], incorporating [[Contemporary classical music|contemporary composition]] and North American genres like [[Country music|country]], forms of [[Rock music|rock]], [[Trap music|trap]], and [[Rhythm and blues|R&B]]. Conceptually, they have based their music and artworks on [[Aymara people|Aymara]] belief and Latin American [[Queer theory|queer theory]]. They are one half of the duo Los Thuthanaka, along with their brother [[Joshua Chuquimia Crampton]]. The two siblings identify with the Pakajaqi nation of Aymara people.

In 2025, they were awarded the [[Venice Biennale]] Silver Lion award following the release of Los Thuthanaka's [[Los Thuthanaka|self-titled album]] that spring. The album was named by [[Pitchfork (website)|Pitchfork]] as the best album of 2025.
